Name: Green Coops and Barns
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
Ever wanted your animals to be in a more outdoorsy place, instead of the (not so good) wood buildings Robin built? But still wanted to keep them somewhere you'd know they'll stay safe and cozy all year? I know I did, so I made this!
[line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Features[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Maps that stay in a permanent spring[/b], so your animals can have the outdoor vibes without freezing in winter.
[*]Maps are the exact [b]same size as vanilla[/b], but they have areas with [b]NPC blockers to keep animals away[/b]. You can use them to freely place machines or decorate. Don't worry, animals still have plenty of free space left to roam!
[*][b]Recolor compatible![/b] Choose the interior recolor you are using in the config menu, or leave it as 'Vanilla' if you aren't using any. 
[*]Every map has [b]a small pond[/b] inside that expands with upgrades - it's mostly for visuals, because I like the idea of my animals having a natural water source inside, but you can also use them to refill your watering can.
[*]As a small bonus, [b]every grass tile is diggable and the interiors work as greenhouses[/b], so you can plant anything you want!
[/list][line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Config[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Map Recolor:[/b] Vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15049]Elegant[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic[/url]﻿. Defaults to 'Vanilla' and will override any other recolor.
[*][b]SVE's Premium Buildings:[/b] true, false. Defaults to 'true' (won't do anything if you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]).
[*][b]Jen's Mega Buildings:[/b] true, false. Defaults to 'true' (won't do anything if you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/url]).
[*][b]Resource Chickens' Giant Coop:[/b] true, false. Defaults to 'true' (won't do anything if you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21800]Resource Chickens[/url]).
[/list][b]NOTE:[/b] 'Map Recolor' is for the interior's room borders and feeding troughs, everything else uses base game tilesheets and will be affected by any recolors you are using.[line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Compatibility[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#93c47d]Works[/color][/b] with [color=#93c47d][b]all world recolors[/b][/color] and the [b][color=#93c47d]interior recolors listed before[/color][/b]!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url][b]﻿'s 'Overcrowding' talent:[/b] [b][color=#93c47d]Compatible![/color][/b] This mod includes bigger maps to fit more animals and will automatically change to them when you get the talent, so there's no need to disable anything on their side!
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/url]:[/b] [b][color=#93c47d]Compatible![/color][/b] Replacement maps are now included as of 1.0.2, but you can turn them off in the config.[b]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21800]Resource Chickens[/url]﻿'s giant coop:[/b] [b][color=#93c47d]Compatible![/color][/b] Replacement map is now included as of 1.0.2, but you can turn it off in the config.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿'s premium buildings:[/b] [b][color=#93c47d]Compatible![/color][/b] I added the map replacements in 1.0.2, same as the others. But! I didn't test these, so let me know if there are any bugs!
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url]'s 'Progenitor' and 'Yieldmeister' professions:[/b] [b][color=#e06666]Incompatible [/color][/b]- at least for now! You'll have to choose between getting those professions or getting this mod!
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6196]Animals Need Water[/url]:[/b] I don't play with it so I haven't tested it, but I'm pretty sure the ponds inside won't work. You can always buy a water trough from Marnie, though!
[*][b]Other mods that add new coops/barns:[/b] Won't cause any visual/gameplay bugs, since this mod targets the vanilla maps + the ones listed before only. Please note, however, that [color=#ffe599][b]those in[/b][b]ter[/b][b]iors won't b[/b][b]e changed[/b][/color][color=#e06666].[/color] I don't know of any mods that do this other than the ones I already covered, but you can make a request in the comments if there's one so I can work on a patch for them!
[*][b][color=#e06666]Won't work[/color][/b] with mods that [color=#e06666][b]alter the vanilla coop/barn maps[/b][/color] (obviously).
[/list][line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Install and Uninstall[/i][/size][/color][/b]
These are the same size as the original vanilla maps, so you can install or uninstall this mod at any point and nothing will be lost to the void. There are only two things to take into account:
[list]
[*]If you install this mod mid-save, make sure you don't have any machines or chests where the ponds are, since you might not be able to reach them. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClipMode[/url]﻿ if that happens to reach your things.
[*]The Coop and Big Coop's feeding troughs aren't in the same place as vanilla, so your hay might be shifted when installing/uninstalling mid-save. Simply bomb the hay to remove it. After that the hay will be placed where it is supposed to.
[/list][line]

[/list][line]
